title: Collect the stopped capture’s local trace
command: nodeRepl.write({ trace: typeof maraSkirtTrace === 'undefined' ? null : maraSkirtTrace, owned_tab: typeof maraSkirtTab === 'undefined' ? null : maraSkirtTab.id });
scope: Own in-memory trace collection only, no browser API, new tab, screenshot, capture replay or native repair. This is a saved transcription of actual collector output, not an automatically written first-call trace.
